drivingQuestion: From where do we know that all three mis-called animals are sanctified?
outcomeNote: The question is answered in the next unit (bekhorot.sugya388)

segments.he: קָרָא לַתְּשִׁיעִי ״עֲשִׂירִי״, וְלָעֲשִׂירִי ״תְּשִׁיעִי״, וְלָאַחַד עָשָׂר ״עֲשִׂירִי״. תָּנוּ רַבָּנַן: מִנַּיִן שֶׁאִם קָרָא לַתְּשִׁיעִי ״עֲשִׂירִי״, וְלָעֲשִׂירִי ״תְּשִׁיעִי״, וְלָאַחַד עָשָׂר ״עֲשִׂירִי״, שֶׁשְּׁלָשְׁתָּן מְקוּדָּשִׁין?
segments.en: § The mishna teaches: If he mistakenly «called» the «ninth: Tenth, and» the «tenth: Ninth, and the eleventh: Tenth,» all three are sacred, although each has a different halakhic status. The Gemara cites a relevant baraita: «The Sages taught: From where» is it derived «that if» one mistakenly «called the ninth» animal: «Tenth, and the tenth» animal: «Ninth, and the eleventh» animal: «Tenth, that» all «three of them are sanctified?»
